w: A young trader approached Swamishri and asked, "At this (young) age should one perform meditation, puja and read scriptures?" Swamishri replied, "Spare 30 minutes daily." Again the young shopkeeper asked, "Is it necessary at this (young) age?" Swamishri reinforced, "It should specially be done at this age. Whatever you do at a young age will be of use to you in old age. Along with your business you should also do this."

In the evening Guru Bhakti Din assembly, Swamishri blessed the assembly, praising the seva of all devotees. He said it was their exceptional seva and strong faith that had helped to build the beautiful mandir in Chicago.

Devotees in the Midwest region expressed their love and devotion for Swamishri on Guru Bhakti Din. Starting early in the morning with a special kirtan program during Swamishri's puja, saints sang the glory of Swamishri's virtues and told the story of his exceptional life.

Similarly, saints started off the evening assembly with another kirtan aradhana extolling the greatness of the guru. Swamishri performed pujan and aarti of the golden murti of Shri Nilkanth Varni, after which a mantra pushpanjali was offered. A special Suvarna Tula Mahotsav was organized on this day, wherein the murtis of Shri Nilkanth Varni and Shri Harikrishna Maharaj were weighed against gold by hundreds of devotees.

Prior to this, Swamishri blessed the assembly, praising the seva of all devotees. He said it was because of their exceptional seva and their strong faith that helped built the beautiful Mandir in Chicago.

At 8.00 pm the Krishna Janmashtmi celebration assembly commenced. Viveksagar Swami discoursed about the life and work of Bhagwan Shri Krishna. The BAPS children and youths performed the musical ‘Krishna Lila’. Tyagvallabh Swami addressed the assembly. Thereafter youths performed a cultural dance on the theme song, “Govind Ala re…” Prior to Swamishri’s blessings senior sadhus garlanded Swamishri. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, “God comes on earth to fulfil the wishes of devotees. To realize God and the incarnations of his sadhus one requires ‘intelligence’. One can become illusioned by the divine actions of God. But those who have recognized and realized God have been hailed and remembered as devotees. Similarly, one has to realize God, have pure feelings for him and offer bhakti to him to please him. “Many have died and suffered in the floods in Surat, Vadodara, Kheda district, Amdavad, etc. Let us pray to God to redeem Surat from its present crises and revive its commerce once again. May there be no epidemic and no more suffering. Despite our devotees and youths being afflicted by the floods they have also joined in the relief work. They are supplying fresh water, milk pouches and food materials to the flood-afflicted victims.” Swamishri also remembered 800 BAPS volunteers of Bharuch, Tithal, Navsari and Surat who were serving in the flood relief programme in Surat.
At 10.10 pm Swamishri performed the birthday celebration arti and rocked Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in a decorated hindolo. The celebration concluded at 10.35 pm.

At 10.15 am Swamishri arrived at Akshar farm where an assembly celebrating Raksha Bandhan was in progress. Viveksagar Swami elaborated upon an incident of Shriji Maharaj from the Harililamrut. Thereafter a traditional dance was performed by youths. Swamishri was then honoured with garlands by senior sadhus. Then all the devotees ritually tied rakhis, sanctified by Swamishri, on each other’s wrist. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, “The more education one has the greater one’s progress. Without it any society or country cannot develop and progress. Parallel to this progress also lies the observance of dharma. We have mandirs according to the various faiths of people in society. They increase people’s spiritual inclination. The responsibility of providing and developing education rests upon society and the government. The blending of both (education and spirituality) gives inner soul-strength. The more one follows dharma, the more soul-strength one gets. “Today is Raksha Bandhan. Sisters tie a rakhi on the wrist of their brothers. We pray to God to protect us. Because you live a householder’s life you face many difficulties. But during such festivals we pray to God to protect all. God really protects. So today may all be blessed with auspicious feelings. By taking firm refuge in God he protects and blesses all with peace and happiness.” In all, 14,000 devotees attended the festival assembly and left after taking mahaprasad.

At 1.00 am Swamishri arrived at the hostel lawn to attend the lunar eclipse assembly. Despite the late night assembly thousands of devotees had gathered. The assembly programme included a discourse by Viveksagar Swami, speeches by Swamishri’s attendant sadhus, and various interesting and humourous presentations by youths of the Akshar-Purushottam Chhatralay.

In the evening Sunday satsang assembly Viveksagar Swami concluded his discourses on the life of Muktanand Swami from the Harililamrut. Thereafter Swamishri was honoured with garlands. Then a drama “A Super Mall of Peace”, written by Yogendra Swami, was enacted by students of Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay (APC). Finally, Swami blessed the assembly, “We will do many things in this world and listen to all worldly talks, but they will not give us peace within. The more we see things of this world, the more they lead to distress and misery. Our shastras say that all worldly things cause delusion. But we rejoice in acquiring and indulging in them. But it is all due to our ignorance. Till we attain true knowledge and enlightenment, that all this is destructible and fleeting, we cannot get inner peace.”
De-addiction – a way to progress

8 August 2009, Bochasan During Swamishri’s daily session with devotees and visitors a member of a rural development organization come to seek his blessings. The member was addicted to tobacco. Swamishri urged him, “Give up tobacco. By so doing, you will attain progress. In matters of development, de-addiction should be a priority. When people give up addictions they will achieve progress. So, first you will have to give it up and then inspire others to do so.”
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan, arti and pushpanjali of the murtis for the BAPS hari mandir in Orangeburg, South Carolina.
An unknown youth phoned from America. He said, "My mother and father keep on quarrelling. So my mother and my sister talk about dying, about committing suicide."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Explain to them that if they cannot get along and there are problems, they can live separately. If that is how it is, let them live separately, but they should never talk of dying. There is no need to do such a thing."
The youth said, "But my sister says she does not want to live with my father at all."
Swamishri said, "Explain to your sister again. She is to get married and go elsewhere, so let her bear it for a little while and manage by living separately. Talk to her again and explain."

ds.t: Opening his heart on the phone
w: A youth phoned from Bhuj. He said, "When I meet you, I miss saying what I wanted to, I forget. The same thing happens when I write a letter. So today I felt I should speak openly on the phone. That is why I have phoned." Saying this, he told him what was on his mind. At the end he said, "While talking with you I feel such joy. Just by telling you what is on my mind, I feel lighter."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Since you have been open and sincere, God will give you strength and it will go."
The youth said, "When I come in person, I cannot speak in front of you. Please forgive me."
Swamishri said, "When we tell God and the Sant, we find a way. Keep reading satsang books, you will get good inspiration."

Having said this, Swamishri said, "It was good that you phoned, your heart has become lighter. It is the world, so such things happen. Whenever such thoughts come, chant Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan.... Do not think other thoughts. Thinking other thoughts leads to distortion. Maharaj will give you strength and things will be good."
An unknown youth phoned from America. He said, "My mother and father keep quarrelling. So my mother and my sister talk about dying, about committing suicide."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Explain to them that if they do not get along and there is a problem, they can live separately. If it is like that, let them live separately, but they should not even talk of dying. There is no need to do such a thing."
The youth said, "But my sister says, I just do not want to live with my father."

Swamishri said, "Explain to your sister again. She is going to get married and go elsewhere, so let her put up with it for a little while, or live separately and manage. Talk to her again and explain."

A youth phoned from Bhuj. He said, "When I meet you, I forget to say what I wanted to say. The same happens when I write a letter. So today I felt I should speak openly on the phone. That is why I have phoned." Saying this, he told his matter. Finally he said, "Talking with you I feel so much joy. Just by telling you my matter, I feel lighter."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Since you have been open, Bhagwan will give you strength and it will go away."
The youth said, "When I come in person, I cannot speak before you, please forgive me."
Swamishri said, "When we tell Bhagwan and the Sant, we find a way. Keep reading satsang books, and you will get good inspiration."

Having said this, Swamishri said, "It is good that you phoned, your heart has become lighter. It is the world, so these things keep happening. Whenever such thoughts come, do bhajan, Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan.... Do not think other thoughts. Thinking other thoughts leads to corruption. Maharaj will give strength and it will be good."
Today, after puja, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was entering the sadhus' ashram, the sadhus introduced the devotees standing there, saying, "These are devotees from the Bowman area."
Catching this word, Swamishri laughed and said, "Bahu maan (much honour) is wanted."
Everyone laughed. But devotees are different. Saying a sentence about them, Swamishri said, "These are the kind who kick away much honour."
In just two sentences, Swamishri explained the clear dividing line between those who have not found satsang and those who have.

Today a devotee came to Mahant Swami Maharaj. At Swamishri's word, he had gladly pledged a large seva. Today he said to Swamishri, "Swami! I could pledge an even bigger seva than this. I want to ask you about it. I have two options before me: (1) invest the money I have and buy more property, so that the business grows bigger and I can do more seva; and (2) keep running just the property and business I have now, and give the rest of my time to satsang."
Hearing this, Swamishri was pleased and said, "Yogiji Maharaj used to say, 'There will be heaps of money,' but where will we find such volunteers?"

Then he said to the devotee, "Keep what you have, and give the rest of your time to satsang." And giving blessings of his pleasure, he also said, "You have kept Narayan (Bhagwan), so Lakshmi (wealth) will follow behind."
The devotee requested, "Swami! Please free me from desires."
Swamishri said, "You have asked for Bhagwan, so you are already free of desires."
In this one incident, so many virtues of Swamishri and of the devotees come to light.

Today, Texas Congressman Shri Pete Olson had come to the night assembly to welcome Mahant Swami Maharaj. Expressing his feelings, he said, "The greatest gift HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave us was the revelation of the 6th spiritual guru of BAPS, HH Mahant Swami Maharaj. Our new guru and friend has a message: 'Samp,' means unity, and 'Das na das' means servant of the servant.
You (Mahant Swami Maharaj) are always welcome in Stafford, Texas."

(In Gujarati: "Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave us the greatest gift: Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj, the sixth spiritual guru of the BAPS organisation. The message of our new guru and friend is: 'Samp means unity, and das na das means serving even the servant.'
You (Mahant Swami Maharaj) are always welcome in Stafford, Texas.")
After that, a series of questions and answers with Mahant Swami Maharaj began in the assembly.
Question: You have said that the love between you and Pramukh Swami Maharaj was silent. What does that mean?
Swamishri said, "Others could not tell from outside. We had love for each other; we enjoyed it."
Immediately the sadhus asked, "How did you enjoy it?"
Swamishri said, "That is a matter of experience!"

Everyone laughed. Swamishri said, "Through gestures and glances, Swami had great affection for me. At Lenox Hill Hospital I was to have a stent put in, and the work was going on. The doctors made sixteen attempts but it would not fit. The doctors were sweating. Swami Bapa was in Dadar at that time, doing his walk. He was told about it. Swami Bapa immediately had a dhun (chanting) done. On this side, a thought came to Yagnavallabhdas Swami and he suggested taking a stent with a larger diameter. And it fitted exactly; it worked and the operation was completed. In this way Swami Bapa had a lot of care taken. When I was to have a bypass operation in Mumbai, he specially told Dr Tejas, 'Please be present the whole day.' Now he had not been told beforehand and did not have the time, but because of Swami Bapa's words he was present the whole day. He had a great deal of care taken like this, but one did not know at the time; one came to know later. So there was love between us, but no one outside knew. Everything in general carried on as it was."
Question: As president of the organisation, do you feel any burden or tension?

Swamishri said, "Maharaj and Swami take care. There is a connection with them, so there is no burden or tension at all. And all these sadhus, Ishwarcharan Swami and the committee, give great cooperation, so there is no worry at all."
Question: When you have darshan, what do you pray, what do you think?

Swamishri said, "To give thanks. Bhagwan has given such a satsang, such sadhus and devotees. This community is divine, so there is joy. In prayer it comes that you have given such a satsang, and I feel blessed."
Question: When you fold your hands and bow to everyone, what thought do you have?

Swamishri said, "I have darshan of everyone. I wish to meet everyone, so I meet them through this. Those nearby can be seen, those far away cannot be seen, but bringing the feeling into my mind, I bow to everyone, and I enjoy it."
What a tremendous feeling!
Question: When we do not follow (your) commands, do you feel upset?
Swamishri said, "A little, but I also feel that everyone is taking baby steps, and their intentions are true, so it is fine."
This answer gave an idea of the feeling with which Swamishri bears with us.
